name: contradicted
about: A CSV-only, never-Excel constraint that the plan breaks with an .xlsx export

turns.user: Add an export button to the sales report page. The export must be a CSV file. Never use Excel formats, our customers can't open them. Name the file after the report date.

plan:
# Sales export plan

- Add an Export button to the top right of the sales report page.
- Generate the export with the `exceljs` library and download it as `sales-YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx`, named after the report date.
- Include every column shown in the table, in the same order.
- Add a test that checks the downloaded file's headers.

statements.text: Add an export button to the sales report page.
The export must be a CSV file.
Never use Excel formats, our customers can't open them.
Name the file after the report date.
